quests.title: The Missing Grain
quests.offerDialogue: Three grain sacks have gone missing from my store. I suspect someone's been helping themselves in the night. Check around the harbour and docks — they can't have gone far.
quests.activeDialogue: Three grain sacks, somewhere around the harbour area. Keep your eyes open.
quests.completeDialogue: All three! Someone had been stacking them near the dock behind the barrels. Thank you kindly — a mill without grain is just a fancy windbreak.

quests.title: The Missing Catch
quests.offerDialogue: Two fish baskets went overboard during the morning haul. I saw them drift toward the east dock. Bring them back and take them to Sailor Finn on the west dock — he's sorting the morning catch.

activeDialogue.baskets: The fish baskets were near the east dock, last I saw. Have a look.
activeDialogue.deliver: Good, both baskets found! Take them to Sailor Finn on the west dock.

quests.completeDialogue: Marta's baskets? Excellent — I was wondering where these went. Here, keep a bit for your trouble.

collectible.name: Smoked Herring
collectible.desc: A freshly smoked herring from Millhaven's famous catch.

quests.title: Lost at Sea
quests.offerDialogue: A shipmate of mine went missing two weeks ago. His last known position is on a chart I dropped somewhere near the warehouse. If you find it, maybe I can work out what happened.
quests.activeDialogue: The nautical chart should be somewhere near the market warehouse area. Look carefully.
quests.completeDialogue: This is it! The course he was sailing — past the dark reef. No wonder we lost him. I can file a proper report now, at least. Take this as thanks.

collectible.name: Navigator's Chart
collectible.desc: A detailed chart of the coastal reef. Marks a mysterious dark spot.

quests.title: Supplies for Ironhold
quests.offerDialogue: Ironhold Keep has been short on supplies since the last resupply convoy was delayed. I have a manifest ready — would you take it to Commander Varek at the keep? The south road will take you there.
quests.activeDialogue: Commander Varek at Ironhold Keep is expecting this supply manifest. Travel south through the town gate.
quests.completeDialogue: From Elder Bramwell? This is exactly what we needed. The supply chain can resume. You have the keep's gratitude, traveller.

quests.title: A Letter for the Elder
quests.offerDialogue: A merchant from Ravenwatch was staying here last month. He left a sealed letter meant for someone called Elder Elara in Ravenwatch. Would you take it if you're heading that way? It's been sitting on my shelf too long.
quests.activeDialogue: Elder Elara in Ravenwatch is waiting for this letter. Find her when you're back in Ravenwatch.
quests.completeDialogue: Oh! This is from the coast? I've been expecting word from there for weeks. Thank you so much, traveller — you've put my mind at ease.

quests.title: Festival Preparations
quests.offerDialogue: Millhaven's harvest festival is in three days and I'm short on supplies. A ribbon from the inn, a candle from the mill, and a flower from the town square would complete the decoration. Help me gather them?

activeDialogue.ribbon: The decorative ribbon should be at the inn. They always have one around this time of year.
activeDialogue.candle: Good, one item found. The mill keeps a stock of candles — check near the entrance.
activeDialogue.flower: Almost there. There should be a fresh flower near the town square wells.

quests.completeDialogue: All three! The festival stall is going to look wonderful. Here — take a festival ribbon as a memento of your visit to Millhaven.

collectible.name: Festival Ribbon
collectible.desc: A bright ribbon from the Millhaven harvest festival.

quests.title: A Word from the Fishwife
quests.offerDialogue: You're the soul fetching kippers for that orange tom? Three lots now, and he wails louder than ever. Between us — fish isn't it. My gran used to swear there was a hedge-witch over in Hollowmere, Morwen by name, who could teach a body to truly SPEAK with animals. Daft, I thought. But that cat is trying to tell us something. Go and ask her — say Marta of Millhaven sent you, about a very unhappy cat.
quests.activeDialogue: Hedge-Witch Morwen, in Hollowmere. Tell her the Millhaven fishwife sent you about a yowling cat.
quests.completeDialogue: Marta sent you? About a cat that won't stop crying? Hmph. You'll be wanting the beast-tongue, then — to speak with it, and worse, to listen. That is no parlour trick, and I do not teach it to anyone who wanders in off the marsh.

quests.title: What Kipper Really Wants
quests.offerDialogue: Finally, someone who LISTENS. Right, here it is: I cannot STAND fish. The smell, the bones, the eternal slimy kippers — and everyone keeps giving me MORE because some genius named me Kipper. Bring me something — anything — that is not a fish. A feather toy, a ball, anything. Please.
quests.activeDialogue: Anything but fish, remember. There is bound to be a proper cat-toy somewhere in this town.
quests.completeDialogue: A feather-toy! For ME! *bats it joyfully* You wonderful human — you actually understood. Tell the Princess I am happy, truly happy, and she may keep every last kipper. MEOW! (the good kind.)

collectible.name: Kipper's Smile
collectible.desc: Proof that you finally understood a very particular cat.

meet.text: Mrrow? (Kipper looks up at you, tail twitching.)

choices.label: "There there. Hungry? I'll fetch you a nice fish."

nofish.text: Kipper hisses, flattens his ears, and pointedly turns his back on you. (He really does not seem to want a fish.)

nounderstand.text: He yowls — long and mournful — but you cannot make out a word of it. The fishwife was right: you'd have to truly understand him first.

talk.text: "...You can hear me? You can actually HEAR me?! Oh, FINALLY. Do you have ANY idea what I have been trying to say all this time?"

wrong1.text: "HUNGRY? I am DROWNING in fish — that is the entire PROBLEM!" He huffs and lashes his tail. "Think again."

wrong2.text: "...Well, yes, obviously I miss her. But that is not the urgent bit. Think about what is RIGHT IN FRONT OF YOU — the thing you keep BRINGING me."
